Lena (Sales): Heads-up: NovaHealth asked to accelerate UAT by 5 days and wants a short trial with BYO-KMS + streaming summarization + batch rerank. They pushed for p95 < 250ms and ~60 qps sustained.
Miguel (Solutions): that's aggressive for the feature set. Do they require live streaming latency or can we stream chunked results?
Lena (Sales): they want streaming for UX but said rerank can be async if its cheaper. Their QA wants 92% pass on the provided prompts.
Priya (SRE): 60 qps + streaming + rerank = higher token rates. We can do: generation on quantized small model (dedicated pool) + CPU rerank using embeddings. That keeps p95 feasible.
Tom (Security): BYO-KMS for a short trial requires a scoped wrapper. We typically only allow full BYO in Private/Dedicated with a contract addendum. Legal will need the diagram and control list.
Miguel (Solutions): proposed execution plan:
- Day 0: confirm exact prompt set + whether rerank must be synchronous
- Day 1: provision small Dedicated pool + ephemeral VPC peering request sent
- Day 2: BYO-KMS exception request to legal + prep key-wrap flow (if approved)
- Day 3: run targeted perf evals and quality runs
- Day 4-6: customer UAT window, standby rotation

Simple eval command we use: 
```
./uat_eval --task summarization_stream --prompts uat/nh_prompts.json --model rwd-small-q --concurrency 8 --steady 300 --metrics latency,p95,quality
```

Priya (SRE): rough expectations from quick sandbox runs: rwd-small-q @ 50 qps -> p95 ~210ms, quality ~90%. At 60 qps p95 jumps to ~280ms. Streaming adds ~20-40ms overhead depending on chunk size.
Lena (Sales): customer question: cost for 1-week Dedicated; also want a line item for adding synchronous rerank mid-UAT.
Miguel (Solutions): cost note: one-week dedicated => pro-rated reserved capacity + ephemeral network egress. Synchronous rerank adds roughly +50% compute depending on approach. I'll assemble a ballpark.
Tom (Security): retention/PII note: default logs 14 days for trials, option to extend in Dedicated. We'll provide redaction guidance for PHI. Will draft answers for the questionnaire now.
infra-bot: provision request #998 queued for redwood-dedicated-small (ETA ~3h) :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Priya (SRE): immediate blockers: 1) customer infra needs to approve VPC peering (1-2 business days), 2) BYO-KMS needs legal ok (can be same-day paper if limited scope), 3) dataset with PHI needs DPA addendum.
Miguel (Solutions): quick decision call: two tradeoffs: (A) meet latency by reducing model size -> lower quality; (B) keep quality -> increase dedicated capacity and accept higher cost. Recommend (A) for first half of UAT then toggle to (B) if they accept cost.
Lena (Sales): I'll pitch that phased approach. Need numbers for both options and the questionnaire draft by EOD.
Priya (SRE): I'll run two short baselines and post results (model small-q vs small-fp16). 8-concurrency, 60s ramp, 300s steady.
Miguel (Solutions): also add an embedding-only rerank option: run embed ops on CPU fleet and rerank asynchronously; almost zero additional latency to generation, but final ranking will be delayed. Good compromise.
Tom (Security): uploaded BYO-KMS architecture sketch and FAQ here: /links/security/nh-byok-sketch.pdf. Legal flagged DPA for PHI.
Priya (SRE): baseline results posted: small-q -> p95=220ms @50qps, quality=89%; small-fp16 -> p95=360ms @50qps, quality=93%. Embedding-rerank CPU test: added latency to generate path ~+12ms, final rerank delivered ~0.8s later. Logs: /links/internal/uat/1973456789.
Lena (Sales): customer decision point: accept phased UAT (start with small-q at 50qps then optional bump to fp16+extra capacity) and accept BYO-KMS as scoped exception. They asked for cost differential now.
Miguel (Solutions): I'll produce a short SOW with two line items and delta cost for enabling sync rerank and for enabling BYO-KMS support.
Tom (Security): I'll coordinate with legal for the BYO-KMS exception and send the questionnaire answers and PHI handling notes.
Lena (Sales): thanks team. I'll update NovaHealth and lock the dates.
